records.exact_submitted_prompt:
Generate an image with the following prompt, dont change it(DO NOT CHANGE THIS PROMPT, IT'S ALREADY AN IMPROVED PROMPT) - 

Primary request: 2000-2010年代照片，展示各种各样的不同的浴池，没有人，如同随手拍摄的数码相机画面，美国，构图不太好
Scene: An empty 1990s airport hotel indoor Jacuzzi next to glass bricks at night, somewhere in the United States. One independently photographed bath, as seen in a casual photograph taken during 2000–2010.
Style and photo quality: Ordinary amateur compact CCD digital camera snapshot from the 2000s. Real non-studio lighting at the location, mixed white balance, modest softness and grain, imperfect exposure, no oversharpening. The image should feel like an unremarkable holiday snapshot.
Composition: A single landscape photograph, imperfect casual crop and a slight accidental tilt, not a carefully arranged architectural photograph.
Aspect ratio: 4:3.
Constraints: Empty room, no people and no reflected humans. No collage, no baked loading interface, no watermarks, no giant text.
Avoid: Modern HDR, cinematic polish, professional real-estate photography, excessive sharpness.
records.postprocessing: Pillow RGB conversion, LANCZOS resize from 1448x1086 to 1280x960, WebP quality 86 method 6; no artwork created by code
records.visual_inspection: Single empty landscape bath photograph; no people or human reflections, no collage, no loading UI, no watermark; casual CCD-style exposure and tilt.
